observed.facings.png: Three facings at one scale on a checkerboard. South is a broad, squat quadruped seen head-on. It has a tall cream central horn rising from the brow, two curved cream cheek tusks, a red knobbly head and shoulders, and a brown-olive wrinkled body and legs with blunt clawed feet. East is a side profile of the same animal: a domed knobbly back, red forequarters, brown hindquarters, a tall back-curved horn, a forward-curving cheek tusk and a low-carried head. North is a rear view: brown haunches and legs, red shoulder knobs at the sides, and the tips of the central and cheek horns peeking above the back. The north body is clearly narrower than the south (about 205 px wide against about 315 px), so it looks like a smaller, slimmer animal from behind.
observed.south.png: Front view, face toward the camera. A heavy brow, small deep-set eyes, a wrinkled snout and a hanging lower lip. A tall pale central horn and two thick cheek tusks curving outward and forward. A red knobbly head and shoulder mantle over a brown wrinkled body. Wide-set columnar legs. Clean alpha.
observed.east.png: Side profile facing right. A massive low-slung body with a hunched domed back covered in rounded knobs. Red head, neck and shoulders that blend into an olive-brown body. Thick wrinkled legs. A tall horn curving back, as long as the head or longer, and a cheek tusk curving forward under the face. Painterly and realistic. Clean alpha.
observed.north.png: Rear view: haunches, a short tail area and the hind legs with deep wrinkles. Knobbly brown back, red knobs on the shoulder flanks, and horn tips visible over the back. No face or eyes. The silhouette is noticeably narrow and tall compared with the south facing. Clean alpha.
observed.scale.png: East facing beside a vanilla human at max zoom. The reek is about 2 cells long and about 1.2 cells tall, slightly taller than the human. At 32 px per cell it reads as a red-and-brown horned bulk, clearly larger than the rat and the human.
